### Quand consulter un médecin ?
Consultez un professionnel de santé (comme via [Soignez-moi.ch](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXRtTjFLxC0RNHX0y5GDaxfvq0GIvGCehXGhhL8uUgMQT9zvhUUz7KQHJ12yucRlnMYxgb2cdN8HG2TPMARbZWekP-h30vcX8wpbxlBa4c_JdHc3VfDTu0hG1s8yE5Dm0-sO2MpWemGV5opLFdB7B7wsbKHUjjk2fk) pour un avis rapide) si :

- La douleur persiste **au-delà d'une semaine à 10 jours**.
- Elle apparaît après un **accident** ou un choc (coup du lapin).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXRtTjFLxC0RNHX0y5GDaxfvq0GIvGCehXGhhL8uUgMQT9zvhUUz7KQHJ12yucRlnMYxgb2cdN8HG2TPMARbZWekP-h30vcX8wpbxlBa4c_JdHc3VfDTu0hG1s8yE5Dm0-sO2MpWemGV5opLFdB7B7wsbKHUjjk2fk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF10W6JaojHZJXvPNZu-NscZynabty7066Jk1YzRSJM4op924pBAgfJ-fdi8tdb4rG2BpLSCeboHul5IAx2gwMMV_68i43wQHuWex86bGN3zTQNhsVIu1Nu43g7uDhA1X6C4msYgnzkbrmx9_JsJABiLdy9Ha6aFwt59Uo2aG916e7u9M-iVPx9_MHhzJTS0S8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF125IAZAxfceME2frDJNGH3iS7MgcfcES1hl9QHuSPuPqayOVTgONaOOAvClgkPuFOd5pckR_k8irFTUD5F7z5l7CvArHz5KAMIjL_2YFyvBGWwlevHHw2iyjr7koSCQVZH2lMCUb_CIoHfbVvi5zOlYasTm9mScmLOcGe1A8ucXaj2fm0WY)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF1z4tv0FtTiTU9bQt88iTRg2u3gDCLfueW4wbV8Sr-BHFVHMA2h_93-V5Nccuev4WDe8dJGcGnzOsg5730nKeKrJ1cfy1831xRrO0gIMzyJr68NAfclXJdlI76QLRsYTMvtZuaZh7YQI-bb2dmlsoFVp899wpghCDW6eNwJlzCLY9uQ6nffUPH2s)
